alias_disposition: Concrete Python engine; historical v13:y0 and seed:071 name the same project, not two implementations.
selected_path: Unconditional ID on one declared finite-discrete DAG/ADMG; conditional queries only through identified joint distribution and normalization. Native IDC disabled.
reason: Existing symbolic ID path can support causal graphs beyond the local DAG back-door reference while the restricted interface preserves query and graph meaning. BSD three-clause conditions support local research integration; exact reference examples and a conversion/failure contract are available. No whole-package correctness or runtime performance is assumed.

alternatives.route: Adopt as an unrestricted direct API
alternatives.reason: Would bypass scientific-context validation and expose the source-level conditional/serialization hazards. A narrow adapter must preserve question, coordinates and unsupported outcomes.

alternatives.route: Port ID and IDC into a new engine
alternatives.reason: Adds algorithm/maintenance responsibility without measured environment or latency need; source issue does not justify copying it. Revisit only if an exact dependency or measured integration constraint defeats reuse.
Small supplied-DAG back-door and iid path; it does not answer the proposed latent front-door query. Failure to find adjustment is not general nonidentification.

Primary manual documents conditional ID and other paths, special graph encoding, GPL>=2 and igraph. A separate R boundary, exact licensing/deployment design and actual numerical comparison are necessary; it is not a verified substitute or a product-wide loser.

alternatives.route: Ananke or other Python identification engines
alternatives.reason: Catalog leads do not provide a completed pinned source/rights/behavior comparison here. No capability absence or equivalence inferred.

source_and_maintenance.finding: Pinned 2026-04-13 tree and project metadata identify maintainers, workflows and tests. No passing CI, current issue resolution, release SLA or measured upkeep is established.

target_and_uncertainty: Symbolic P(Y | do(A),Z), optional later scalar contrast. Preserve graph, population, units, horizons, action order, domains and sampling context. No point estimate, confidence calibration, decision value or graph truth arises from identification alone.

conversion_and_failure_contract.anchor: Selected adapter conversion/dispatch/refusal and environment contract

behavioral_oracle.anchor: Exact front-door, observational equivalence and collider references

known_categories: Twelve direct runtime dependencies and their resolved transitive artifacts
Isolation, serialization, quotas, logs and regression maintenance
License notice inventory and engine updates
measure_before_claiming: Fresh environment setup time and retained disk footprint
Actual whole-request wall time, memory and output size
Correct/unsupported/failure rates on declared reference suite

owner_obligations.proposal_author: Preserve scope and negative source findings; do not advertise native IDC or causal correctness from installation.
owner_obligations.prototype_implementer: Resolve and hash exact distributions, retain all license notices, bind platform/build logs, execute real engine references, implement lexical AST scopes and explicit unsupported outputs.
owner_obligations.scientific_reviewer: Review request/graph model and independent references before any capability claim.
owner_obligations.future_operator: Qualify process budgets, supported workloads and transport behavior before production claims.

admission_sequence: Resolve an isolated reproducible environment inside causal; retain actual engine/build/dependency identities and license evidence.
Implement only the reviewed path and execute actual ID/front-door/bow plus conservative conditional-collider and conversion/refusal cases.
Record observed failures before any adapter capability; do not call an independent reference stub the engine.
Integrate scoped observed results into the monograph; continue other language/LLM/public-data branches independently.
revisit_triggers: A corrected pinned conditional separation path plus independent actual-engine collider evidence may enable native IDC.
Failure of engine expression conversion or admitted reference cases requires narrowing/repair before enablement.
Dependency license/environment incompatibility triggers the independent R or alternative Python review.
A measured deployment/latency need may justify a port, with new verification obligations.
limitations: This decision enables local implementation work only; IN.ADAPTER.Python is still unperformed.
Dependency versions, transitive rights, actual imports and resource bounds remain environment-specific admission work.
All example probabilities and monetary illustrations are generated proposal references.
